subject.title: feat(memory): add excludePaths option to memorySearch config

question: Should OpenClaw ship a builtin-only public `memorySearch.excludePaths` config key now, or wait for broader QMD/recall eligibility parity?
rationale: The code repairs are mechanical, but adding a public config key that intentionally does nothing for QMD is a product boundary choice.

options.title: Ship builtin-only after repairs
options.body: Repair merge semantics, index identity, and docs generation, then ship the narrow builtin backend feature with a clear QMD caveat.

options.title: Require QMD parity first
options.body: Hold this PR until the same exclusion semantics are designed and tested for QMD indexing.

options.title: Fold into broader eligibility design
options.body: Pause or supersede this PR in favor of the wider recall and index path-scope design tracked in the related feature issue.

recommendation.title: Ship builtin-only after repairs
recommendation.body: Repair merge semantics, index identity, and docs generation, then ship the narrow builtin backend feature with a clear QMD caveat.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses published config, memory docs, and core product scope where steipete has the strongest combined ownership signal.
